event_section.hydrographic_context: Sanguerone tributary of the Sentino within the Esino basin

network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto mostra l'idrogramma del Sentino a Colleponi e altre sezioni dell'Esino, ma non una sezione idrometrica sul Sanguerone compatibile con il ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The report shows the Sentino hydrograph at Colleponi and other Esino sections, but no Sanguerone gauge section compatible with the bridge.

sources.title: Rapporto di evento: maltempo 15, 16 e 17 settembre 2022

curation_note.it: Il caso condivide con IT22.09.07 e IT22.09.09 lo stesso tributario e la stessa piena. ARCUS mantiene nullo il dato locale finché non emerge una misura sul Sanguerone temporalmente compatibile.
curation_note.en: This case shares the same tributary and flood with IT22.09.07 and IT22.09.09. ARCUS keeps the local value null until a time-compatible Sanguerone measurement is found.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official regional event report and waterbody registry

caveats: The Colleponi hydrograph is on the receiving Sentino, not on the Sanguerone.
No stage, discharge or hydrograph is assigned to the bridge section.
The report graph is not manually digitised into a false-precision numeric peak.
Basin processes do not by themselves prove the bridge-collapse mechanism.
